# Historical AI fixtures

These unchanged scenarios used a separate AI document or event hints to claim unexecuted invocation, validation, autonomy, review, proxy, provenance or fallback operations. They are retained for traceability and explicit retired-input refusal tests. They do not count as executable positive rule coverage or processor profile evidence.

Native supported policy stages remain in the parent fixture directory and the independent native policy/replay corpora. Full invocation/preconditions remain fs-w9dv, governed output commitment fs-t9h8, and general synthetic operation evidence fs-pzju. Native agent alignment is fs-k07m. The inventory records original bytes and baseline; original referenced documents are recoverable from that commit and the schema lane historical fixture archive.
